name: desmin

function.text: DES encodes desmin. Annotated molecular activities include structural constituent of cytoskeleton and cytoskeletal protein binding. It participates in cytoskeleton organization and muscle contraction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to dilated cardiomyopathy 1I (autosomal dominant); myofibrillar myopathy 1 (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.
